import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int M = 1000007; // maximum edges
    static int[] vv = new int[M];
    static int[] nxt = new int[M];
    static int[] cap = new int[M];
    static int[] h;
    static int[] pre;
    static int[] vis;
    static int e;

    static char[][] s1, s2;
    static int[][] id;
    static int cnt, s, t, T, n;
    static int xz, yz;
    static int[] q1 = new int[500];
    static int[] q2 = new int[500];
    static int[][] v1, v2;
    static int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && s1[x][y] >= '0' && s1[x][y] <= '9';
    }

    static void add(int u, int v, int c) {
        vv[e] = v; nxt[e] = h[u]; cap[e] = c; h[u] = e++;
        vv[e] = u; nxt[e] = h[v]; cap[e] = 0; h[v] = e++;
    }

    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        // add edges for the current cell
        if (s2[x][y] != '\0') {
            add(id[x][y] + cnt, t, s2[x][y] - '0');
        }
        if (s1[x][y] == '0') return;
        add(s, id[x][y], s1[x][y] - '0');
        if (s2[x][y] != '\0') {
            add(id[x][y], id[x][y] + cnt, 10);
        }

        int sx = x, sy = y;
        int h1 = 0, t1 = 0, h2 = 0, t2 = 0;
        q1[t1++] = x; q1[t1++] = y;
        q2[t2++] = xz; q2[t2++] = yz;

        int up1 = t1, up2 = t2;
        // initialize v1 and v2 to -1
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(v1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(v2[i], -1);
        }
        v1[x][y] = 0;
        v2[xz][yz] = 0;

        int nx, ny;
        while (h1 < t1) {
            // process current layer of digit BFS
            while (h1 < up1) {
                x = q1[h1++]; y = q1[h1++];
                if (v2[x][y] >= 0) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    nx = x + dir[i][0];
                    ny = y + dir[i][1];
                    if (inside(nx, ny) && v1[nx][ny] < 0) {
                        v1[nx][ny] = v1[x][y] + 1;
                        if (v1[nx][ny] > T) break; // break out of for loop
                        if (v2[nx][ny] >= 0) continue;
                        q1[t1++] = nx; q1[t1++] = ny;
                        if (s2[nx][ny] != '0') {
                            add(id[sx][sy], id[nx][ny] + cnt, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            up1 = t1;

            // process current layer of zombie BFS
            while (h2 < up2) {
                x = q2[h2++]; y = q2[h2++];
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    nx = x + dir[i][0];
                    ny = y + dir[i][1];
                    if (inside(nx, ny) && v2[nx][ny] < 0) {
                        v2[nx][ny] = v2[x][y] + 1;
                        q2[t2++] = nx; q2[t2++] = ny;
                    }
                }
            }
            up2 = t2;
        }
    }

    static boolean bfsMaxFlow() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0, t + 1, 0);
        vis[s] = 1;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = h[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (cap[i] > 0 && vis[vv[i]] == 0) {
                    int v = vv[i];
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (v == t) return true;
                    vis[v] = 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsMaxFlow()) {
            int flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int edge = pre[v];
                flow = Math.min(flow, cap[edge]);
                v = vv[edge ^ 1];
            }
            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int edge = pre[v];
                cap[edge] -= flow;
                cap[edge ^ 1] += flow;
                v = vv[edge ^ 1];
            }
            ans += flow;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        s1 = new char[n][n];
        s2 = new char[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            s1[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            s2[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        // initialize adjacency list
        int maxNodes = 2 * (n * n) + 5; // safe upper bound
        h = new int[maxNodes];
        pre = new int[maxNodes];
        vis = new int[maxNodes];
        Arrays.fill(h, -1);
        e = 0;

        id = new int[n][n];
        for (int[] row : id) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    xz = i; yz = j;
                } else if (inside(i, j)) {
                    id[i][j] = ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        s = 0;
        t = 2 * cnt + 1;

        v1 = new int[n][n];
        v2 = new int[n][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inside(i, j)) {
                    bfs(i, j);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxFlow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
